name: UltimaKit – WordPress Admin Tools, Security & Performance Optimizer
author: Ankit Panchal

sections.description:
Is your WordPress site weighed down by too many single-purpose plugins?

UltimaKit is the modular WordPress plugin toolkit that replaces 50+ common plugins with one clean, performance-optimized solution. Enable only the modules you need — if a module is off, its code doesn’t run.

Plugins You Can Uninstall

By installing UltimaKit, you can safely remove these popular plugins and reduce your plugin count:

  • Yoast Duplicate Post → UltimaKit’s Duplicate Pages & Posts
  • SVG Support / Safe SVG → UltimaKit’s SVG Upload
  • Disable Gutenberg → UltimaKit’s Gutenberg Manager
  • WPS Hide Login → UltimaKit’s Change Login URL
  • Limit Login Attempts → UltimaKit’s Login Security
  • Redirection → UltimaKit’s 301 Redirect Manager
  • Cookie Notice → UltimaKit’s GDPR Compliance Tool
  • Simple Custom CSS/JS → UltimaKit’s Code Manager
  • Maintenance Mode → UltimaKit’s Maintenance Mode
  • Post Types Order → UltimaKit’s Drag & Drop Sort Order

Top Free Features

The most popular tools included in the free version:

  • Duplicate Posts & Pages — Clone any post or page with a single click
  • SVG Upload Support — Safely upload SVG logos and icons to the Media Library
  • Disable Gutenberg — Revert to the Classic Editor for specific post types or the entire site
  • Hide Admin Notices — Move annoying plugin banners out of your dashboard to a dedicated panel
  • Drag & Drop Order — Reorder Posts, Pages, and Custom Post Types with a simple drag
  • Login Customizer — Change the default /wp-admin login URL and replace the WordPress logo

Complete Free Feature List

Content & Management

  • Duplicate Pages & Posts — Clone content instantly
  • Drag & Drop Order — Custom sorting for posts and pages
  • SVG Upload — Enable safe SVG file uploads
  • Auto-Generate Slugs — Create SEO-friendly slugs automatically
  • Featured Image Column — See thumbnails directly in the admin list view
  • ID Column — Display Post/Page IDs in the admin table
  • Clean Up Admin Bar — Remove “Howdy Admin,” WP Logo, and other clutter
  • Open External Links in New Tab — Automatically add target=”_blank”

Security & Hardening

  • Change Login URL — Hide your /wp-admin from bots and scrapers
  • Limit Login Attempts — Block brute-force attacks with automatic IP lockout
  • Disable XML-RPC — Prevent a common DDoS and brute-force attack vector
  • Hide WordPress Version — Obfuscate version number to prevent targeted exploits
  • Block “Admin” Username — Prevent creation of the most common insecure username
  • Disable File Editing — Stop hackers from editing theme/plugin files via the dashboard
  • Auto-Logout Inactive Users — Session security for idle admins
  • Disallow Bad Requests — Block malicious strings and base64 injections

Optimization & De-Bloat

  • Disable Gutenberg — Revert to Classic Editor where needed
  • Disable Emojis & Embeds — Remove extra JavaScript files to speed up the frontend
  • Disable Comments — Turn off comments globally or per post type
  • Disable RSS Feeds — Stop content scrapers
  • Disable Cart Fragments (WooCommerce) — Fix the #1 WooCommerce speed issue
  • Heartbeat Control — Reduce server resource usage from the WP Heartbeat API
  • Remove Query Strings — Improve GTmetrix and PageSpeed Insights scores

Custom Code & Design

  • Header/Footer Code — Add Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, or any custom script
  • Custom CSS/JS — Add style tweaks without editing theme files
  • Custom Admin Footer — White-label your dashboard for clients
  • Login Page Styler — Hide login errors and shake animations

Pro Features (Agency Power)

Unlock the full site management suite for agencies and developers:

  • SEO Title & Meta Editor — A lightweight alternative to heavy SEO plugins
  • Custom Post Types (CPT) UI — Create CPTs and Taxonomies without writing code
  • Admin Activity Logger — Track every change made on your site with a full audit log
  • Maintenance Mode — Professional “Coming Soon” pages with a countdown timer
  • White Labeling — Rename “UltimaKit” to your own agency brand
  • Advanced WooCommerce Tools — Disable breadcrumbs, custom “Add to Cart” text, and more
  • Gravity Forms Modules — Advanced form management and field utilities
  • Export/Import Settings — Move your configuration to client sites instantly

sections.installation:
1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to UltimaKit in the admin sidebar.
  4. Enable only the modules you need to keep your site fast and lightweight.
sections.faq:
Why should I use UltimaKit instead of installing separate plugins?

Every plugin you install adds HTTP requests, database queries, and potential security risks. UltimaKit lets you replace 20+ single-purpose plugins (like Duplicate Post, SVG Support, Disable Gutenberg) with one clean, optimized codebase. Less plugins means a faster, more secure site.

Does enabling many modules slow down my site?

No. UltimaKit uses a strict modular architecture — if you do not enable a module, its code does not run at all. It is significantly more efficient than running 10–20 separate plugins.

Can I use this for client sites?

Yes! The White Label and Clean Admin Pro features make it perfect for agencies. You can rename UltimaKit to your own brand and hand over a clean, professional dashboard to clients.

Is it compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. There are dedicated WooCommerce optimization modules in both Free and Pro tiers, including disabling cart fragments (the #1 WooCommerce speed issue), hiding out-of-stock products, and customizing the checkout experience.

Is the free version genuinely useful or just a teaser?

The free version includes 30+ real, fully functional modules covering content management, security hardening, and performance optimization. The Pro tier adds advanced tools for agencies and power users.
